facts.title: World Class flow balance
facts.text: 25% cooldown reduction, 4% movement speed, slight M2 pass auto-track, +1 dribble, 7% lower tackle cooldown, 5% more shot/volley power.

history.title: Master Of All Trades changes
history.text: Master Of All Trades became World Class and received a revised set of bonuses; Reo gained two awakening cutscenes.

history.title: NEL Reo return and rework
history.text: NEL Reo returned with striker and defensive kits that change with field side, plus separate awakening kits.

history.title: Reo and flow rework
history.text: Reo reworked to analyse and copy allies and enemies; associated flow rework.
